about.title: About OQTutor
about.content: Online Quran Tutor (OQTutor) is a premium global platform dedicated to delivering high-quality Quranic and Islamic education. We bridge the gap between students and qualified tutors, bringing interactive learning classrooms right to your home. Whether you are a beginner taking your first steps with Noorani Qaida, or looking to master advanced Tajweed and Hifz, we provide a supportive and professional learning environment designed for all ages.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: Our mission is to make Quranic education accessible, engaging, and spiritually enriching for Muslims around the world. We aim to preserve the true rules of Tajweed and pass down accurate recitation skills through certified male and female scholars. By utilizing modern online learning tools, we strive to build a strong foundation of Islamic values and character in young children and adults alike.

curriculumSteps.title: Arabic Alphabet Recognition
curriculumSteps.description: Mastering the individual shapes, names, and variations of all 28 Arabic letters in written form.

curriculumSteps.title: Correct Articulation (Makharij)
curriculumSteps.description: Training the throat and tongue positions to vocalize throat and mouth letters accurately.

contact.aboutText: Online Quran Tutor (OQTutor) is a leading global online platform providing dedicated 1-on-1 Quran, Tajweed, and Islamic Studies education for students of all ages. Our mission is to make Quranic learning accessible, engaging, and spiritually rewarding.

faqs.question: What is the recommended age for kids to start online Quran classes?
faqs.answer: We recommend children be at least 4.5 years old to start. At this age, children can follow instructions on screen. We use interactive, game-based learning models to keep them engaged.

faqs.question: Do you provide female Quran teachers for female students?
faqs.answer: Yes. We have dedicated certified female scholars available for sisters and young children. You can request a female or male teacher when signing up.

faqs.question: How do payment methods and monthly billing work?
faqs.answer: We accept major credit/debit cards, Stripe, PayPal, and bank transfers. Billing occurs monthly, and there are no contracts or cancellation fees.

faqs.question: Do you offer family discounts for multiple enrollments?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer up to a 15% discount for families registering two or more students. This discount is automatically applied during packages selection.

faqs.question: What is your refund or money-back policy?
faqs.answer: We offer a 100% satisfaction guarantee. If you are not satisfied with your classes during the first 7 days, we will issue a full refund, no questions asked.
